ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a food web diagram, and the arrows indicate that food or energy flows from the party being eaten to the consumer. In the figure there are arrows from Grass to Cricket, Sheep, and Deer; there is an arrow from Cricket to Rat; and there are also arrows from Rat to Owl and Wolf. Reasoning: Because in the figure Cricket points to Rat, it shows that rats eat crickets or rely on crickets as food. If crickets become fewer, the rats' food source will decrease. A decrease in food will cause the number of rats to decline, and in serious cases rats will die. Therefore, the rats will die.
